2125699274432516096.en_summary: Bluekurtic says sorry bulls, but the price action we saw in $QQQ today isn't typical of a healthy uptrend. The Nasdaq 100 rallied over 2% from a 3%+ gap down. 10 days out, QQQ was down in 7 of prior 8 cases. And at some point within 10 days, it always fell further by 6.3% median.
2125699274432516096.zh_summary: Bluekurtic表示抱歉多頭，但今日$QQQ看到的價格行為並非健康上升趨勢的典型。納斯達克100從超過3%的缺口下跌反彈超過2%。10天後，QQQ在先前8個案例中有7個下跌。並且在10天內某時點，總是進一步下跌中位數6.3%。

ticker_notes.QQQ: 從3%+缺口反彈2%+後，歷史10天內7/8下跌，中位進一步跌6.3%
